facts.text: The image is a multi-panel creature reference sheet devoted to a single black dragon, with one large cinematic panel across the top and seven smaller panels arranged in two rows below.
In the top panel, a large black dragon stands in a dark volcanic landscape, body oriented left with its head lowered and a huge membranous wing extended upward and to the right.
The dragon has a reptilian quadrupedal build, large bat-like wings, a long tail, long pale tan curved horns, clawed feet, and rows of spikes along its back and tail.
The middle row contains three full-body views labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and REAR, showing the dragon with wings spread against a plain dark background.
The bottom row contains four detail panels labeled HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT, and SCALE DETAIL.
The head close-up shows layered dark scales, long pale tan horns, and an orange eye; the scale detail shows dark scales with subtle blue-green iridescence.
The top panel background includes jagged dark rock formations, smoke or haze, glowing orange lava, and dark wet reflective ground; the lower panels use a neutral dark gray backdrop.
Visible text labels are exactly: FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, REAR, HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT, SCALE DETAIL.
